description.value: Parthenon Pizza is a Greek-inspired pizza restaurant in Esquimalt with 45 years of culinary experience behind its signature pies. The menu features seven named Greek pizzas — from the all-meat Spartan to the Athens Vegetarian — alongside wings, salads, and 16-flavour ice cream. Cyclists can eat in or order for pickup, with delivery also available.

address.value: 612 Head Street, Esquimalt, British Columbia V9A 4Y6, Canada
